description: Mechanical API migration across ~10 caller files
prompt: Migrate all callers from the deprecated `legacyRequest(url, opts)` API in lib/http.js to the new `request({ url, method, body })` API (already implemented). Update every file under callers/ and remove the legacyRequest export. All tests must pass. After migration, no source file may contain the identifier legacyRequest. Do not modify *.test.mjs files.
verify: node callers/all.test.mjs && ! grep -R --include='*.js' -n 'legacyRequest' . && test -f lib/http.js && git diff --quiet HEAD -- '*.test.mjs'
